description: The headless autocomplete core of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5. SvAutoComplete is one styled renderer over createAutocomplete, which owns free text with a live-filtered suggestion list where any typed value is kept and suggestions are shortcuts, plus the roving active index, keyboard and ARIA, exposed as inputProps, listboxProps and optionProps. The same core drives the styled component and a custom suggestion-list render over one text value.

faq.question: How is this core different from the combobox core?
faq.answer: It never reverts the text. The value is whatever the user typed, and picking a suggestion replaces it; the combobox core forces the value to come from its options.

faq.question: Can I supply suggestions asynchronously?
faq.answer: Yes. The suggestions are an input to the core, so pass a reactive array you fill from a fetch and the list updates as results arrive.

faq.question: What does optionProps add?
faq.answer: role option, an id for aria-activedescendant, aria-selected for the active item and the pointer handlers that pick the suggestion.
